title: TerrainProblem
description: A real-world problem that persists in a current workflow. Must be solution-neutral — should make sense even if our proposed venture did not exist. All evidence must carry an epistemic label. Never claim WELL_SUPPORTED without supporting evidence items.

title.description: Short, solution-neutral title. Bad: 'Need AI compliance assistant'. Good: 'Compliance teams manually chase missing audit evidence before deadlines'.

description.description: Concrete description of what actually happens. Describe observed work, not product need. Should pass solution-neutral test: 5 different technologies could plausibly address this.

workflowStepIds.description: Which specific workflow steps contain this problem.

contexts.description: Conditions under which this problem occurs or intensifies. e.g. 'month-end', 'high transaction volume', 'cross-border'.

triggers.description: What initiates or reveals this problem.

consequences.description: What happens if the problem is not resolved. Prefer causal chain: 'missing evidence → reviewer waits → approval delayed → shipment blocked → customer payment delayed'.

currentWorkarounds.description: What people actually do today. e.g. 'Manual M&V consultant', 'Excel reconciliation', 'phone calls to chase documents'.

satisfactionLevel.description: How well does current alternative meet the need? HIGH = problem may be weak.

desiredOutcomes.description: Solution-neutral outcome statements. Format: direction + metric + object + context. e.g. 'Minimize the time to verify all retrofit performance evidence is complete before payment settlement.'

epistemic.description: OBSERVED = directly witnessed. AI_HYPOTHESIS = inferred by model from existing repo data. Never promote without real evidence.

sourceId.description: References a record in data/sources.json. Required for SOURCE_SUPPORTED_INFERENCE and above.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting this problem. All items must have epistemic label. Counterevidence must be stored separately to prevent suppression.

counterEvidence.description: Evidence AGAINST this problem being real or important. Must not be discarded. §32.

status.description: HYPOTHESIS = AI/analyst inference only. Must escalate only when real evidence exists.

symptomOrRoot.description: Is this a surface symptom or root cause? §40.

parentProblemId.description: If this is a sub-problem of a broader problem.

importanceSignals.description: Observable signals of importance: 'staff assigned', 'deadline', 'penalties', 'repeated escalation', 'overtime'. §62.

asOf.description: Date this problem record was authored. Problems decay. §280.

researchGaps.description: Key claims that need direct user evidence before escalating status. §474.
